closure_definition: Input/trigger: user requests / with no session, with a valid session, or after logout. Core behavior: protect the homepage, render authenticated content only for valid sessions, and invalidate sessions on logout. Observable result: anonymous and expired sessions redirect to /login, authenticated sessions see identity and welcome content, and logout removes access for the old cookie.
acceptance_criteria: AC-UNIT-2-001: GET / without a valid session returns 303 and redirects to /login.
AC-UNIT-2-002: GET / with a valid session returns 200 and renders the configured login identity, welcome content, and a logout action.
AC-UNIT-2-003: POST /logout with a valid session returns 303, redirects to /login, expires the browser cookie, and removes the server-side session.
AC-UNIT-2-004: GET / with the old cookie after logout returns 303 and redirects to /login.
exclusions: Business dashboards, analytics, personalization, and complex visual polish are not part of this unit.
Persistent database-backed sessions are not part of this unit.
priority_basis: The protected homepage and logout behavior complete the user-visible authentication loop.
